desc:
Give your dog a tag with character. This Orlivane ID tag features a raised breed portrait framed by a vintage border, laser engraved with your pet's name and your phone number so a neighbor can call you if your dog wanders off.

Specifications:
- Material: cupronickel (copper-nickel alloy), antique bronze finish
- Size: 4.5 cm (1.8 in) diameter, 2.5 mm thick, 34.7 g
- Engraving: name on the front, phone number on the back
- Includes: 1 tag + shackle ring
b: 3D BREED RELIEF DESIGN — Raised dog portrait on a round cupronickel tag with a vintage bronze finish. 15 breed styles, including Golden Retriever, Samoyed, Pug, Schnauzer, Corgi, Pomeranian, French Bulldog, Border Collie, German Shepherd and Cane Corso.
ENGRAVED THE WAY YOU WANT — Name on the front and phone number on the back. Enter your text in the customization box.
SIZED FOR MEDIUM AND LARGE DOGS — 1.8 in (4.5 cm) wide, 2.5 mm thick, about 1.2 oz (34.7 g).
SHACKLE RING INCLUDED — A sturdy D-shaped shackle with screw pin attaches the tag to most collars and harnesses.
MADE AFTER YOU ORDER — Each tag is laser engraved for you. Please double-check spelling before you submit.
kw: personalized dog tags for dogs engraved custom pet id tag metal dog name tag vintage breed dog tag with name and phone
